messages:
emily: Opening a small PR to align SDK snippets (py/ts/go) for streaming + retries + pagination. Found mismatched cursor names and two different TS reader patterns. Draft will include tiny retry helpers and a clear doc note: cursor is opaque. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3892

jay: Awesome. Can you standardize on `cursor` (opaque string) and show a client-side loop for pagination in each language? Also please include a 2-line partial-JSON accumulation for TS streaming.

emily: Yep. Plan: Python async generator with resume token example, TS both `for await` and `getReader()` plus small retry util, Go SSE-style scanner loop + minimal backoff helper. Add migration note about legacy `page_token` and eventual consistency.

frank: For TS partial JSON:

```ts
let buf=''
for await (const c of client.chat.stream({model,input})){
  buf += c.text
  try { const obj = JSON.parse(buf); handle(obj); buf = '' } catch { /* wait */ }
}
```

jay: For pagination examples show this pattern (TS):

```ts
let cursor: string|undefined = undefined
while(true){
  const r = await client.items.list({limit:50, cursor})
  r.items.forEach(handle)
  if(!r.cursor) break
  cursor = r.cursor
}
```

nora: Small nit: include a note to not parse `cursor` and recommend a short re-fetch window if items appear missing after migration (edge cache eventual consistency).

docs-bot: Draft PR by emily: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3892  labels: docs, examples, migration

emily: Thanks all  I'll request reviews from @jay and @frank and add a backport checklist for archived quickstarts.
